children.name: text

Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, but subject to the Contract, the Contractor shall in designing such works, ensure that:

children.name: text
children: the Contract Works items are designed for the Contractor by appropriate consultants in accordance with the proper professional architectural or engineering practices and principles;

children.name: text
children: insofar as the Contractor is responsible for elements of the design, all services included in the Contract Work items are professionally designed exercising all reasonable skill and care to be appropriate adequate and as described or reasonably able to be inferred from the specifications;

children.name: text
children: the documentation is co-ordinated with all other contract documentation;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall take out suitable Professional Indemnity insurances for the designed elements; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall provide a design Producer Statement to the Engineer for items designed and constructed by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor agrees to provide such reasonable assistance to the Principal and the Principal’s consultants when requested by the Principal, to maximise integration opportunities with the Contract Works so that the costs of any other work to be carried out by the Principal are minimised to the extent reasonably possible.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor acknowledges that to facilitate the Project and achieve the Milestones in accordance with the Project Programme, the Principal may require the Contractor to work together with any other contractors of the Principal to achieve all reasonable consistency of approach and efficiencies.

children.name: text

The Contractor shall, without prejudice to the foregoing, communicate with and attend to each subcontractor to ensure any subcontracted work is completed in accordance with the Contract Documents and the Contractor shall make good any defect or damage upon completion of each subcontractor’s work.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be responsible for the adequacy, stability, and safety of all Site operations including the security of the plant and equipment and the safe, secure storage of the materials in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations and methods of construction, provided that the Contractor shall not be responsible for the design or specification of the Contract Works except as provided under 5.1.3 and 5.1.4.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Principal requests it, the Contractor’s input on the Drawings and Specifications shall be to advise on the following aspects whilst maintaining or improving at all times the quality of the design (using all due care, skill and diligence):

children.name: text
children: construction and practicability of build, including environment, health and safety;

children.name: text
children: ways of reducing waste and improving sustainable outcomes for the project;

children.name: text
children: ways of affecting time savings or improving ease of construction; and

children.name: text
children: minimisation of design errors and omissions, particularly in design co-ordination.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall prepare and submit to the Engineer two-weekly written reports (1 report every 2 weeks) in relation to the Contract Works. The reports shall be in a format required by the Engineer and shall cover all aspects of time, cost, quality, environment, sustainability and safety and any other matters identified by the Engineer acting reasonably.

children.name: text
children: ensure that the execution of Contract Works does not interfere with the property or other rights of third parties unless the consent of such persons and the Principal has been obtained; and

children.name: text
children: be responsible for ensuring that it does not interfere with services or utilities which are located in the vicinity of the Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will undertake and pay for all costs of repair and reinstatement works without reimbursement by the Principal where it has interfered with the property or other rights of third parties without the consent of those third parties and of the Principal, or interferes with services or utilities located in the vicinity of Contract Works in a manner not agreed with the service or utility provider concerned and the Principal and will indemnify and save harmless the Principal from and against all costs, claims, damages and liability arising out of or in consequence of any such matters.

children.name: text
children: Where provided in the Special Conditions, the Principal may arrange for work on the Site not included in the Contract to be carried out by Persons other than the Contractor including the Principal’s employees and concurrently with the carrying out of the Contract Works. The Principal shall ensure that in carrying out any such work any Separate Contractors shall in all respects comply with all reasonable requests from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: a breach of the Contract by the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: negligence by the Contractor or a Subcontractor relating to the performance of the Contractor’s obligations under the Contract;

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: impact to the project due to COVID-19.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor undertakes that before a Subcontractor or Separate Contractor commences work on site, the Contractor will obtain similar warranties to those in 5.7.5 from that Subcontractor or Separate Contractor in relation to the sub-crontract works or separate works, as the case may be.

children.name: text
children: The Engineer shall not be bound to grant an extension unless:

children.name: text
children: The Contractor notifies the Engineer that it claims an extension and states the grounds for the extension;

children.name: text
children: The notice is given within 10 Working Days after the circumstances arise which are relied on as the grounds for extension, or as soon as practicable thereafter;

children.name: text
children: The notice either gives details of the period of extension sought or is followed within a reasonable time by a further notice giving such details; and

children.name: text
children: The event or circumstance in respect of which the extension is sought must or will cause actual delay to the critical path elements of the Contract Works, which the Contractor must show and demonstrate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Engineer.

children.name: text
children: The Principal may, at its sole and absolute discretion and notwithstanding any other provision of the Contract to the contrary, at any time and from time to time and for any reason it considers sufficient but without being under an obligation to do so, by notice to the Contractor unilaterally extend any Due Date for Completion. For the avoidance of any doubt, any such extension will not require the Contractor to slow down the progress of the Contract Works and the Contractor is entitled to complete the Contract Works and any Separable Portion prior to the date of any such extended Due Date for Completion. The Principal is not entitled to exercise its right under this 10.3.8 in order to defeat an entitlement of the Contractor under 10.3.7.

children.name: text
children: It will be a condition precedent to Practical Completion for the Site and the Contract Works to be in a clean and tidy condition and free of waste material, rubbish and litter. If in the opinion of the Engineer the Contractor has not left the Site and the Contract Works clean and tidy and free of waste material, rubbish and litter, on being requested by the Engineer, the Contractor must immediately tidy up the Site and the Contract Works to the satisfaction of the Engineer. In the event that the Contractor fails to tidy up the Site and the Contract Works to the satisfaction of the Engineer, the Engineer shall be entitled to employ a third party to tidy up the Site and Contract Works, the cost of which, alongside any penalties imposed by Kainga Ora (which may be up to $350 per day after the date on which written notice and demand has been made), the Engineer is entitled to deduct from any payments otherwise due to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If any part of the Contract Works is replaced or repaired during the applicable Defects Notification Period, the replacement or repaired item will have the extended Defects Notification Period (commencing from the date that the item has been replaced or repaired to the satisfaction of the Principal) stated in the Special Conditions.

children.name: text
children: The Principal will be entitled to deduct or set off against any sums that would otherwise be payable by it to the Contractor, amounts in respect of any claims it has against the Contractor including, without limitation, damages awarded by a court or tribunal for breach of contract by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor agrees to the Principal that the Contractor will not do anything, or omit to do anything, or use or permit to be done, omitted or used, materials, substances or processes which:

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: or that would or could cause any adverse effect on the environment; or

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: does or is likely to give rise to the issue of an abatement notice, enforcement proceedings or an excessive noise direction against the Principal, Contractor or Subcontractor under the Resource Management Act 1991 or the Building Act 2004.

children: The Principal has entered into a contract (the 'Contract') with the Contractor for carrying out the Contract Works. The Warranted Works are part of the Contract Works.

children: The Warrantor has agreed to provide a warranty in respect of the Warranted Works for the Warranty Period on the terms set out in this warranty.

children.name: text
children: The Warrantor warrants to the Principal that the Warranted Works are as required in the Contract. If not otherwise specified the works shall be in accordance with good trade practice.

children.name: text
children: This warranty shall be in addition to and shall not derogate from any manufacturer's warranty or any warranty implied by law or the Defects Notification Period in the Contract, attaching to any part of the Warranted Works.

children.name: text
children: The Warrantor agrees that, if within the Warranty Period the Warrantor is advised by the Principal in writing of any defect in the Warranted Works for which the Warrantor is liable under the terms of this warranty, the Warrantor will promptly take steps to remedy the defect.

children.name: text
children: Any remedial work which the Warrantor is liable to undertake under this warranty shall be carried out:

children.name: text
children: To the standard required by the Contract;

children.name: text
children: In a prompt and timely manner;

children.name: text
children: Without unnecessary inconvenience to any occupants;

children.name: text
children: Subject to reasonable access being provided to the Warrantor for the purpose of carrying out the remedial work.

children.name: text
children: Where the Cost of replacement of work and/or Materials is out of all proportion to the consequences of the defect, or where the defect may not be reasonably capable of rectification without substantial expense which is out of all proportion to the Cost of the Warranted Works:

children.name: text
children: If the defect is reasonably able to be rectified by repair rather than by replacement, the Warrantor's obligation under this warranty shall be only to repair or otherwise make good the defect;

children.name: text
children: The Warrantor may propose reasonable monetary compensation in lieu of remedying the defect; or

children.name: text
children: The Warrantor may propose a combination of both repair and compensation.

children.name: text
children: The Principal shall consider the Warrantor's reasonable proposals and the parties shall endeavour in good faith to reach agreement. Where agreement cannot be reached, the dispute shall be resolved in accordance with clause 7.

children.name: text
children: {b:Failure by Warrantor to perform remedial work}

children.name: text
children: If the Warrantor fails to promptly, adequately and satisfactorily carry out the remedial work or to propose acceptable repair or compensation, the Principal may then arrange for the remedial work to be carried out by others.

children.name: text
children: The Principal shall first give the Warrantor 10 Working Days notice, or such other reasonable time as agreed by the Principal, to carry out and complete the remedial work. If the Warrantor does not do so within that time, the Principal may then advise the Warrantor in writing that the work will be carried out by other Persons.

children.name: text
children: In such an event, the Warrantor is not released from its obligations under this warranty, which continue in full force and effect, except for the defect remedied by the Principal or by another Person contracted by the Principal.

children.name: text
children: The reasonable Cost of remedial work carried out by such other Persons including all reasonable Costs of the Principal shall be paid to the Principal by the Warrantor on demand.

children.name: text
children: The Principal agrees that the Warrantor is not liable for any defect or damage caused by:

children.name: text
children: Wilful act or negligence of the Principal or any Person other than the Warrantor;

children.name: text
children: Fire, explosion, earthquake, war, subsidence, slips, faulty materials, or workmanship other than caused by the defect in the Warranted Works;

children.name: text
children: Any force of nature which the Warrantor could not have reasonably foreseen;

children.name: text
children: Any neglect or unnecessary delay by the Principal in giving notice to the Warrantor of a defect in the Warranted Works becoming apparent;

children.name: text
children: Design faults, errors, or discrepancies, unless the Warrantor undertook the design of the part of the Warranted Works that is the subject of the defect;

children.name: text
children: Use of the Warranted Works by the Principal or any other Person in any manner or for any purpose not being the intended manner of use or purpose of the Warranted Works;

children.name: text
children: Failure by the Principal or other Person to maintain the Warranted Works in accordance with good practice and any manufacturer's stated or recommended instructions or requirements; or

children.name: text
children: The Principal may assign the benefit of this warranty to any Person.

children.name: text
children: Any dispute between the Principal and the Warrantor arising out of this warranty is to be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator. If, within 15 Working Days of notice of dispute, the Principal and the Warrantor cannot agree on a single arbitrator, either party may request the President of the Arbitrators' and Mediators' Institute of New Zealand to appoint an arbitrator.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor or the Subcontractor (as nominated in Schedule C) (‘the Bailee’) proposes to store the Materials at the premises of the Bailee (‘the Premises’) as identified in Schedule B as bailee for the Principal, for the purpose of storage, fabrication, sub-assembly, or as otherwise required for the Contract Works prior to being delivered to the Site for incorporation into the Contract Works.

children: Description of Materials inclusive of work performed on them:

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Materials to which this agreement relates are those described in Schedule A to this agreement, all of which Materials are currently on the Premises identified in Schedule B.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Premises identified in Schedule B are in the sole control of the party identified in Schedule C and that party shall act as bailee of the Materials until such time as the Materials are delivered to the Site or taken possession of by the Principal.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} undertakings, warranties, covenants, agreements and other obligations of the Contractor or the Subcontractor shall bind and be deemed to have been given or assumed by each of them severally and by both of them jointly.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Contractor and the Subcontractor agree that they will cause the Materials to be set apart at the Premises and be clearly and visibly marked individually or in sets as being the property of the Principal and their destination as being the Site. The method used to mark the Materials and the procedures by which the mark is applied to the Materials shall be as required by the Contract or as otherwise approved by the Principal.

children.name: text
children: {b:NEITHER} the Contractor nor the Subcontractor will permit, allow, or cause the Materials to be taken away from the Premises, except:

children.name: text
children: For the purpose of being transported to the Site and used in the Contract Works; or

children.name: text
children: That the Principal may at its sole discretion take possession of the Materials for use other than for the Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: Where the Principal takes possession of any Materials under clause 5(b) above, and the Contractor thereby suffers delay or the Contractor or the Subcontractor incurs additional cost, the taking of possession shall be treated as a Variation under the Contract, unless the taking of possession is pursuant to clauses 14.2.1 or 14.2.2 of the Contract; and

children.name: text
children: Where the Principal takes possession of any Materials under clause 5(b) above, and additional work has been carried out on those Materials since being paid for by the Principal, the Principal shall pay the Contractor for that additional work in accordance with the Contract before taking possession of the Materials.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Engineer, upon being satisfied that the Materials have been set apart and marked as required by this agreement, and upon the Contractor providing satisfactory evidence that the requirements of clauses 12 and 20 below have been fully satisfied, shall include in any Payment Schedule issued by the Engineer under the Contract a sum representing the reasonable value of such Materials calculated in accordance with the Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:UPON} the Principal having made payment for the Materials, less any retentions or deductions prescribed in the Contract, title to such Materials shall immediately vest in the Principal free of all security interests, charges and encumbrances of any nature whatsoever.

children.name: text
children: {b:WHERE} the Contractor receives payment for Materials and the Subcontractor is entitled to some or all of the Principal’s payment, the Contractor shall promptly pay the Subcontractor for such Materials.

children.name: text
children: {b:UPON} the request of the Subcontractor, the Engineer shall advise the Subcontractor whether the Contractor has received any payment from the Principal for such Materials.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Contractor and the Subcontractor agree that the Materials will be held by the Contractor or the Subcontractor solely as bailee for the Principal and such bailment will constitute a security interest in favour of the Principal for the purpose of the Personal Property Securities Act 1999 (‘the PPSA’).

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Principal shall (at the Contractor’s reasonable cost) register a financing statement on the Personal Property Securities Register (‘the PPSR’) listing the Principal as secured party and the Contractor and the Subcontractor as debtors for any security interest arising from the bailment of the Materials referred to in this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee shall promptly do all things including executing any documents and providing all information which the Principal requires to ensure that the Principal receives and maintains at all times a first ranking security interest in the Materials. This shall include procuring from any third party who has registered a financing statement againstthe Bailee, a waiver, in a form acceptable to the Principal, of any security interest or claim which might otherwise extend to the Materials or their proceeds.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee shall not discharge or amend any financing statement registered under clause 11 above without the prior written consent of the Principal.

children.name: text
children: {b:NOTHING} in sections 114(1)(a), 133, and 134 of the PPSA shall apply to this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:ANY} rights of the Contractor and the Subcontractor as debtors under sections 116, 120(2), 121, 125, 126, 127, 129, 131, and 148 of the PPSA shall not apply to this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee hereby grants to the Principal reasonable, free, and unencumbered right of access to the Premises to:

children.name: text
children: Inspect the Materials, and verify or undertake the marking and setting apart of the Materials;

children.name: text
children: Take possession of the Materials for the purpose of delivery to the Site and inclusion in the Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: Remove the Materials from the Premises for the purpose of delivery to the Site and inclusion in the Contract Works; and

children.name: text
children: Take possession of the Materials for use other than for the Contract Works,

children.name: text
children: and in each case in a manner that does not cause damage to any other property at the Premises. The Bailee shall take all steps and do all things as shall be necessary to ensure that the Principal obtains access to the Premises for the purposes of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee shall not, except as permitted in clause 5, remove or cause or permit the Materials to be moved from the Premises. The Bailee shall nevertheless be responsible to the Principal for any loss or damage thereto and for any costs of storage or handling.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee shall, when required to do so by the Contractor or the Principal, arrange for the transportation of the Materials to the Site. Such transportation shall be at the cost of the Bailee in all things including loading, unloading, and freight.

children.name: text
children: {b:WHERE} the Materials are not insured under the construction policy provided in accordance with 8.3.1 or 8.8.1 of the Contract, the Bailee shall, at its expense:

children.name: text
children: Effect a material damage insurance policy covering all of the Materials subject to this agreement in the name of the Principal to the satisfaction of the Principal, as provided in 8.2.1 of the Contract for the full duration of the off-site storage. Such insurance may include an exclusion for loss or damage sustained during processing;

children.name: text
children: Effect a transit insurance policy for transit of all the Materials from the Premises to the Site in the name of the Principal to the satisfaction of the Principal, as provided in 8.2.1 of the Contract for the full duration of the off-site storage.

children.name: text
children: {b:WITHIN} 15 Working Days of the date of this agreement, the Bailee shall furnish the Principal and the Contractor with evidence of such insurance.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee represents and warrants to the Principal and to the Contractor (where applicable) that:

children.name: text
children: It has good and clear title to the Materials;

children.name: text
children: It has the ability to assign and transfer the Materials to the Principal or the Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: The Materials will be transferred to the Principal or the Contractor free of any security interest.

children.name: text
children: {b:THE} Bailee undertakes that, if it charges or mortgages all or any part of its property (either real or personal), assets, or undertaking, it will obtain written confirmation from the chargee or mortgagee that the charge or the mortgage over such property, assets, or undertaking does not extend to the Materials once they have been paid for by the Principal or the Contractor (as applicable).

children.name: text
children: {b:NOTHING} in this agreement shall be deemed to limit, waive, or affect the Engineer’s powers under the Contract to order the removal from the Site or the Premises of Materials which are not in accordance with the Contract and the substitution by the Contractor at its own risk and expense of proper Materials. Nothing in this agreement shall be deemed to limit, waive or affect any other powers conferred on the Engineer and/or the Principal under the Contract.
